items.title: Finite flat quasi-coherent modules are finite locally free exactly when every closed subset closed under generalizations is open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts an equivalence between a module-theoretic condition on a scheme, that every finite flat quasi-coherent module is finite locally free, and a topological condition, that every closed subset closed under generalizations is open (statement lines 5068-5077). The proof is substantial in its second half: it uses flat closed immersions to get the easy direction, then for the converse shows that the support of a finite flat module is closed under generalization, applies the same reasoning to every exterior power, uses the nestedness of those supports to decompose the scheme into open and closed pieces U_i indexed by the rank, and finally produces a local surjection from a free module of the correct rank and proves it injective by applying the flat-closed-immersion characterisation to the top exterior power (proof lines 5079-5151). It is H2: the argument is a genuine scheme-level construction rather than a citation, but its individual inputs are standard local algebra and the author explicitly says the scheme case simply repeats the affine algebra argument, so no independent research-level claim is made for it.
